title: Germany – Emergency generator – Beschaffung Notstromversorgung mobiles Notstromaggregat 2
description: Mobiles Dieselnotstromaggregat im witterungsbeständigen Metallgehäuse fest verbaut auf LKW-Anhänger, für Fremdeinspeisung einer NSHV. Die Zuschaltung auf eine NSHV im Inselbetrieb bei Netzausfall erfolgt händisch. Die Rückschaltung erfolgt ebenfalls händisch. Es ist eine Netzausfallautomatik und Rücksynchronisierung notwendig. Es ist eine Synchronisierung für den monatlichen Probebetrieb vorzusehen. Das Notstromaggregat steht im Außenbereich, ca. 10 bis 40 m von der NSHV entfernt. Die Vorbereitung und Einholung von Genehmigungen sind in die Preis mit einzukalkulieren und der Dokumentation beizulegen. Inkl. Wartung des kompletten Aggregats gemäß zu erstellenden Wartungsplan. Komplette Wartung mit allen Betriebsmitteln für das gesamte Aggregat. Der beigefügte Wartungsvertrag ist Bestandteil der Ausschreibung. Inkl. Gewährleistungsverlängerung auf 4 Jahre ausgelegt. Die beschriebene Leistung versteht sich inkl. Lieferung, Transport und betriebsfertiges Aufstellen vor Ort.

title: DATA RELAY RF SIMULATOR SYSTEM - EXPRO PLUS (RE-ISSUE)
description: Objectives: The objective of this activity is to develop a system simulator for testing the RF links of multi satellite missions. The focus of the simulator should be the modelling of a full set of satellite and laned assets transmitters and receivers with their precise orbit determination around different bodies of the solar system (e.g. Earth, Moon, Mars).Description: There is a high interest in the development of cluster of data relay satellites for planetary exploration and navigation. There are different studies and developments ongoing related to this concept both for Moon and Mars. Such a simulator system for Moon and Mars is considered an asset to support the development of this cluster missions and to support the development and test of the user terminals in an operating environment.The objective of the activity is hence to develop a RF simulator of a data relay system. The simulator shall be able to interface via RF either with a user terminal unit or with a data relay unit and to: Model full satellite's cluster transmitters and receivers. Model user terminals' transmitters and receivers. Emulate the user terminal spacecraft dynamic motion on planet surface, orbit, or during descent and ascent from the surface: Doppler, Doppler rate and delay. Emulate the relay satellite dynamic motion in orbit: Doppler, Doppler rate and delay. Emulate transmitter and receiver antenna gain and phase patterns of the relay satellite and of the user spacecraft host. Emulate the interference generated by the multiple transmitters of the cluster. Emulate multipath effects. Emulate any atmospheric attenuation or delay effects (for Mars case). Emulate the (two way) range measurement function of the relay link to characterize the performance and functionality.The RF relay simulator shall emulate the signals of each satellite of the cluster in both Sband and K-band in a modular fashion (i.e. S-band module independent from K-band module). The data relay RF simulator system shall employ software in the loop and hardware in the loop techniques to allow the user to design the test scenarios and to control external hardware blocks. The main goal is to have full control of all aspects of the useroperating environment, to enable exact repeatability of the test and to allow the application of systematic errors or incidents that are normally impossible to verify or not tested during the RF compatibility tests. The Emulation of the relay satellites shall be configurable to emulate different relay systems such as different (type of) Moon or Mars scenario.The following tasks are foreseen in this activity: Revision and consolidation of requirements. Architectural and detailed design, including the design of the simulator system at system level and building block level. The detailed requirements for each buildingblock of the system should be derived. It shall be determined if each building block need to be developed or if there are COTS blocks that can be embedded. Implementation of the hardware and software needed to constitute the system simulator prototype. Test and demonstration of the simulator.Deliverables: Hardware prototype, Software, Report.

title: Automation of MultiSensor Turret (TMS) ( B11 )
description:
CNES-CSG wants to digitalize its activities in order to :
•	Reduce reconfiguration delay in between two launches
•	Maintenance and Operation reduction costs
•	Turn the CSG into an attractive spot for new space operators
•	Improve space base availability
•	Daily life improvement and simplification

Description

CNES has optical facilities to follow the launchers after their lift off, for technical and media purposes.
They consist in visible and infrared video cameras, mounted on a turret, called TMS (Multisensor turret). CNES has several TMS.

Up to now, TMS are hand controlled by one or several operators who perform camera configuration and hand follow-up of the launchers

The aim of this activity is to modernize or replace these TMS in order to make them fully remote controlled:
-	Remote set-up
-	Auto-tracking of the launcher

These TMS will be design to endure French Guyana climatic conditions.
In option these TMS will made easily transportable.

Inputs will consist in a requirement specification or a technical specification
Deliveries will consist in one or several automatized TMS, operationally qualified.

title: PMC 3667 - Delivery of a Public Realm automated scheduling, route planning and reporting system for South Dublin County Council
description: 1 Overview Public Realm Section SDCC Public Realm Section plays a pivotal role in maintaining and enhancing the quality of public spaces within the County which is home to more than 300,000 people and 6,500 businesses. There are over 220 outdoor staff in the Public Realm Section who oversee park maintenance, grass cutting, waste management, village cleansing, tree management, maintaining playgrounds, meadows and areas for biodiversity, etc. In total, there are over 1750 ha of parkland and open spaces throughout the County 185 ha of meadows to be managed, over 850 bins, 16 high-profile towns and villages, 59 parks, 57 playgrounds, installation and management of soft and hard landscaping schemes, etc. All recreation facilities, bins, grass-cutting areas, etc have been digitally mapped throughout the county. All SDCC vehicles have a GPS installed. As part of this tender process, SDCC requires the tender winner to provide an optimized route planner. 2. Preliminary Market Consultation (PMC) SDCC is conducting a Preliminary Market Consultation (PMC) to gather information from potential service providers for developing a scheduling system for the Public Realm Section. This system will automate planning, scheduling, task reporting, and data capture with a user-friendly interface that offers efficient service access, real-time updates, and a feedback mechanism for continuous improvement. Integration with existing council systems and databases is essential to ensure a smooth transition and minimal disruption to current operations while adhering to the highest data security and privacy standards. In order to assist in the development of the approach to the development and provision of this Service, South Dublin County Council would welcome input in advance of the tender process. Service providers are requested to supply details of options available for the effective delivery of this service. Brochures etc are also welcome in electronic format. Contact Details: via electronic mailbox on www.etenders.gov.ie Please refer to attached document for further information. Portal workspace status: Proposal Submission Closed
